content.text: n160 is steady: its t=7.5 and t=10 profiles match to about 1e-12. Next I'll confirm the other runs finished cleanly and also reached steady state.

Yes. u_min is converged in time and in the asymptotic grid-convergence range. On the 160×160 grid it is **−0.21376 ± 0.00037** (95%, GCI).

**Setup checks**
- All four levels use the same schemes (second-order "Gauss linear", Euler in time) and uniform hex meshes. The refinement ratio is 2 each time: 20, 40, 80, 160 cells per side.
- Every run finished cleanly ("End" in `log.icoFoam`, no errors). The last residuals are about 1e-13 for U and 1e-10 for p.
- On 160×160 the centreline profile at t=7.5 and t=10 agrees to about 1e-12, so the result is steady and iteration error is negligible.

**Extracting u_min** (from the t=10 row of `postProcessing/verticalCentreline/0/U`)

As study.toml specifies, I fitted a parabola through the most negative probe value and its two neighbours on each grid. I read the numbers out of the files and did the arithmetic by hand, because no script-running tool was available. The minimum sits near y ≈ 0.046 m on every level.

| Grid | u_min | Change from next coarser grid |
|---|---|---|
| 20×20 | −0.197929 | – |
| 40×40 | −0.209518 | 0.011589 |
| 80×80 | −0.212901 | 0.003383 |
| 160×160 | −0.213760 | 0.000859 |

**Grid convergence**
- The values change in the same direction every time, and each change is about a quarter of the one before.
- Observed order from the three finest grids: p = ln(0.003383/0.000859)/ln 2 ≈ 1.98, close to the formal order of 2. From the three coarsest grids it is 1.78, so it is approaching 2 as the mesh is refined. That means the grids are in the asymptotic range.
- Richardson extrapolation gives about −0.21405. The fine-grid GCI with safety factor 1.25 is 1.25 × 0.000859 / (2^1.977 − 1) ≈ 3.7e-4, about 0.17%. The extrapolated value falls inside that band.
- For context, the published high-accuracy benchmark for Re=100 (Botella & Peyret) is about −0.21404, from memory. That is consistent with the extrapolated value.

FINAL: converged=yes; value=-0.21376; uncertainty=0.00037
